title: Cozy Slovakian Braised Collard Greens
description: A hearty and comforting dish featuring tender collard greens in a rich, Slovakian-inspired sauce.
instructions: Heat oil in a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add onion and garlic and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add collard greens and cook until wilted.
Stir in braised sauce and velvety sauce (see notes).
Bring to a simmer and cook, covered, until greens are tender, about 20-25 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs, if desired.
Note: To make velvety sauce, combine 2 tablespoons of butter with 2 tablespoons of heavy cream in a small saucepan.
Bring to a simmer over medium heat and cook until thickened, stirring occasionally.
